name: capabilities
description: CAT-1..5: a system installed with a feature detector and future forecasts (now-cast + 12/24/48 h). At power-on each consumer shakes hands (reads /collections), tailors itself and subscribes; then it fetches what is announced.

steps.caption: Power-on: three consumers read the catalogue and tailor themselves: the chart display goes HI RES (features offered), the planner 48 h (its furthest window).
A second run: each consumer fetches only what it subscribed to.
